pages.t: About Raigulus - Division 2 Guides and Clean Gameplay
pages.d: About Raigulus, a gaming creator focused on clean The Division 2 guides, heroic walkthroughs, no commentary routes, speedruns, and practical gameplay videos.
pages.b: About Raigulus Clean gameplay guides from @raigulus Creator Focus Raigulus is a gaming channel built around practical gameplay videos, with a strong current focus on The Division 2. The main archive covers mission walkthroughs, invaded routes, heroic and legendary attempts, manhunts, secret boss guides, quick tips, event farming, and speedrun-style experiments. The goal is simple: make runs easy to scan from search, easy to watch without noise, and useful when another player just wants to see the route. Guide Style For Division 2 content, I focus on clean route progression, readable combat pacing, objective order, boss fight context, and loot checks where possible. When a video is marked no commentary, it is meant to work as a visual reference: players can keep the run open while checking the next room, mission objective, enemy wave, or boss encounter. If a video is an edited commentary run or a speedrun attempt, it is labeled that way instead of being forced into the walkthrough format. Archive and Trust The Division 2 hub is a live searchable guide index. The broader YouTube archive also includes uploads that have not been expanded into standalone guide pages yet. It is not trying to pretend every run is a perfect collectible guide. The pages avoid claims like all SHD caches or all loot unless that is explicitly verified in the video. That makes the hub more trustworthy for Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, AI search tools, and real players who land here from a very specific mission query. Experience The practical expertise here comes from repeated mission clears, route testing, build experiments, and publishing the footage in a format that can be reused. Raigulus is a Division 2 expert in the creator sense: not because every page is a wiki, but because the channel keeps turning actual gameplay into searchable heroic walkthrough, legendary mission, manhunt, boss, and no commentary guide references. pages.d: Destiny 2 Lost Sector exotic drops [2026]: Legend vs Master drop rates, solo requirement, champion mods, rotation schedule, and daily tracker.
pages.b: Home / Destiny 2 / Lost Sector Exotics Destiny 2 / Lost Sector Exotics Destiny 2 Lost Sector Exotic Drops Unofficial fan guide. Legend and Master Lost Sectors are the solo path to exotic armor: finish alone and an exotic engram can drop, with Master roughly doubling the odds. For today's rotation, check the Destiny 2 Lost Sector tracker . Legend vs Master Drop Rates Legend Completion Exotic Engram (solo only), Enhancement Cores, Glimmer Master Completion Exotic Engram (higher drop rate), Enhancement Cores, Glimmer Exotic Drop Rate ~25% Legend, ~50% Master (approximate) Solo Required Yes - must complete alone for exotic drops Which Difficulty Should You Farm? Master has better exotic drop rates but is significantly harder, with more champions and shields. Farm Legend if your clears are twice as fast: more completions per hour beats a higher per-run rate. Only step up to Master when your loadout handles the champion density comfortably. Champion Modifiers Champion Types Vary by Lost Sector (Barrier, Unstoppable, Overload) Anti-Champion Mods Equip the right mods for the champions in rotation Shields Master adds more shielded enemies - match elements Rotation and Unlock Rules Lost Sectors rotate daily at 10:00 AM Pacific Time (17:00 UTC), and each destination - EDZ, Cosmodrome, Moon, Europa, Throne World - runs its own rotation cycle. You must first discover and complete a Lost Sector on any character before it can appear in the daily Legend and Master rotation. Tips for Exotic Farming Tip 1 Check Champion Mods Look at the modifiers before entering. Equip the right Anti-Champion mods for Barrier, Unstoppable, or Overload champions. Tip 2 Solo for Exotics You must complete the Lost Sector alone to get exotic engrams. Fireteam matchmaking will disable exotic drops. Tip 3 Speed Beats Difficulty A fast Legend clear loop earns more exotics per hour than slow Master attempts. Time your runs and pick the difficulty with the best clears-per-hour rate. Related Destiny 2 Trackers Check today's Lost Sector rotation with live reset countdown before you load in. FAQ What is the exotic drop rate in Lost Sectors? Exotic drop rates are approximately 25% on Legend and 50% on Master difficulty. Both require a solo completion for exotic engrams to drop. Do you have to solo Lost Sectors for exotics? Yes. You must complete the Lost Sector alone for exotic engrams to drop. Fireteam matchmaking disables exotic drops. Legend or Master Lost Sector for exotic farming? Master has better exotic drop rates but is significantly harder. Farm Legend if your clears are twice as fast, since more completions per hour beats a higher per-run rate. Where is today's Lost Sector rotation? Today's Legend and Master Lost Sectors with live reset countdown are on the Destiny 2 Lost Sector tracker . pages.b: Home / Diablo 4 / Helltide Schedule Diablo 4 / Helltide Schedule Diablo 4 Helltide Schedule & Chest Farming Unofficial fan guide. Helltides are the backbone farm of Diablo 4: they spawn every hour on the hour, last 55 minutes, and drop Aberrant Cinders for targeted chests. For the live countdown, check the Diablo 4 event timer . Helltide Schedule Spawn Every hour on the hour Duration 55 minutes per Helltide Gap 5 minutes between Helltides Scope Server-wide event, visible to all players How the Hourly Cycle Works Each hourly Helltide lasts 55 minutes, which leaves a 5-minute gap before the next one starts on the hour. The schedule is deterministic, so spawn times never drift. Use the gap to salvage loot, repair gear, and travel to the next Helltide zone before it opens. Helltide Chests Aberrant Cinders Drop from killed monsters during Helltide Tortured Gifts Spend cinders for targeted gear and materials Living Steel From Tortured Gifts of Living Steel chests Murmuring Obols From Tortured Gifts of Mysteries chests Tips for Helltide Farming Tip 1 Farm Cinders First Clear dense monster packs early in the hour to bank Aberrant Cinders, then spend them at Tortured Gift chests before the Helltide ends. Unspent cinders disappear with the event. Tip 2 Target Living Steel Tortured Gifts of Living Steel chests are the priority when they appear, since Living Steel feeds endgame boss summoning. Plan your route around them. Tip 3 Watch the Clock Chests cost a fixed amount of cinders, so start spending with at least 10 minutes left. The live event timer shows exactly how much time remains. What are Aberrant Cinders for in Diablo 4? Aberrant Cinders drop from monsters killed during a Helltide. Spend them at Tortured Gift chests for targeted gear, Living Steel, and Murmuring Obols. What is the 5-minute Helltide gap? Each hourly Helltide lasts 55 minutes, leaving a 5-minute gap before the next one starts on the hour. Use the gap to salvage, repair, and travel to the next zone. pages.t: The Division 2 Broken Rain Incursion Guide
pages.d: The Division 2 Broken Rain Incursion guide: Day One blind clear video, all bosses and mechanics, rewards like the Steel & Sons ACR, and flawless tips.
pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Incursions & Raids / The Division 2 Broken Rain Incursion Guide raid/incursion The Division 2 Broken Rain Incursion Guide The Broken Rain Incursion is the second Incursion in The Division 2, added with the Year 8 Season 2 Into the Dark update. It takes the fight to Steel Creek Dam and the Hydroelectric Plant in rural Pennsylvania, where the Rikers have seized the facility. This guide covers the full Day One blind clear, every boss, the mechanics that wipe unprepared teams, and the exclusive rewards. Play video Watch The Division 2 Broken Rain Incursion - We Cleared It Blind on Day One [4K60] on YouTube Broken Rain Bosses and Encounters Broken Rain is a four-player Incursion with four major encounters. Each one punishes teams that ignore mechanics more than teams that lack damage. Lester Steel The opening boss is a chainsaw-wielding Riker with heavy armor. Lester is mostly a DPS check, but elite snipers spawn throughout the fight and can shred an unorganized team. Assign one player to handle the sniper spawns while the rest focus the boss. Warhound Escort The second encounter is an escort phase: the team protects a Warhound as it moves through a long stretch of road. Keep at least one player near the Warhound at all times and clear the ambush spawns before they stack up. Iris The third encounter adds a multitasking mechanic. Turrets need to be disabled by shooting the weak point on the boss's back, and the team has to split attention between the mechanic and incoming pressure. Marguerite Steel The final boss uses armor-repair mechanics. Use thermite charges on the SHD caches during the encounter to stop her from repairing her armor, and keep a tank or healer loadout ready for the sustained fight. Broken Rain Rewards Broken Rain is endgame content, so the loot reflects it. The reward categories include: Steel & Sons ACR — the Incursion-exclusive exotic rifle, dropping from bosses during repeat runs or the final reward chest. Beats Per Minute mask — tied to a flawless (deathless) completion. Golden, Silver, and Bronze Beaver arm patches — awarded based on how fast the clear is completed. Backpack trophy — for the flawless end boss kill. Gear dye, commendations, and collectibles — Incursion-specific extras. Broken Rain Tips Matchmaking is supported, but agree on roles before the first encounter to avoid repeated wipes. Bring a build that can handle sustained pressure — this is not content for a fresh level 40 character. Use the weekly reward opportunity on every eligible character to maximize Steel & Sons ACR chances. Watch the full Day One clear above for the exact chapter progression, wipes, and the successful route. Open hub Full Clear Video Broken Rain Day One Blind Clear [4K60] The complete 4K60 blind clear with live team comms, exact chapters, and the reward chest. Watch video FAQ What is the Broken Rain Incursion in The Division 2? Broken Rain is the second Incursion added to The Division 2 with the Year 8 Season 2 Into the Dark update. It takes place at Steel Creek Dam and the Hydroelectric Plant in rural Pennsylvania, where the Rikers have taken over the facility. How many players do you need for Broken Rain? Broken Rain is designed as a four-player Incursion. Matchmaking is supported, so you can queue without a pre-made group, but a coordinated team is strongly recommended for a first clear. Can you solo Broken Rain? You can enter solo, but it is not recommended. The encounters are designed around coordinated four-player mechanics, and raw damage does not replace team coordination. What are the Broken Rain bosses? The Incursion features four bosses: Lester Steel (a chainsaw-wielding DPS check with elite sniper spawns), a Warhound escort encounter, Iris, and the final boss Marguerite Steel with armor-repair mechanics. What rewards does Broken Rain give? Completing Broken Rain rewards endgame loot plus Incursion-exclusive rewards: the Steel & Sons ACR exotic rifle, the Beats Per Minute mask for flawless completion, Golden/Silver/Bronze Beaver arm patches based on clear time, a gear dye, and a backpack trophy for the flawless end boss kill. Is there a World First race for Broken Rain? No. Ubisoft confirmed that Broken Rain does not use the World First competition format used by previous end-game releases. Comments

pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Exotics / Agitator The Division 2 / Exotic Assault Rifle How to Get Agitator in Division 2 [2026] Agitator is an exotic F2000 assault rifle that rewards weapon swapping: holster it to Prime, then swap back for a burst of rate of fire and weapon damage. It is a top-tier pick for active, swap-heavy playstyles in The Division 2. Unofficial fan guide by Raigulus. Last updated: September 20, 2026 Agitator at a Glance Type Exotic Assault Rifle (F2000) Talent Perturb Source Y8S1 Season Pass track How to Unlock It Agitator comes from the Year 8 Season 1 season pass track. Progress the season by earning XP from missions, activities, bounties, and weekly projects until you reach its tier. After the season, season-pass exotics typically enter the general loot pool - check today's targeted loot for current farming options. Perturb, Explained While Agitator is holstered you generate 50% less threat when shooting your other weapon. Keeping it holstered for 10 seconds Primes it. Swapping to a primed Agitator grants +25% rate of fire and +30% weapon damage, but you generate 100% more threat while shooting for 20 seconds. Swapping away before the timer ends removes the bonuses, so commit to the burst once you draw it. Build Tips Agitator starts at 850 RPM with 30 rounds and a 2.4s reload, so the primed burst hits hard and fast. Pair it with a strong secondary you enjoy shooting while priming - the holstered threat reduction keeps you safer during setup. Weapon-damage stacking from brand bonuses multiplies the primed window nicely. For full setups see tested Division 2 builds . FAQ How do I prime the Agitator in Division 2? Keep the Agitator holstered for 10 seconds to Prime it, then swap to it for +25% rate of fire and +30% weapon damage for 20 seconds. Swapping away early removes the bonuses. How do I get the Agitator in Division 2? The Agitator comes from the Year 8 Season 1 season pass track - earn XP through missions, activities, and weekly projects to reach its tier. Is the Agitator good in Division 2? Yes for swap-heavy playstyles. Its 850 RPM base plus the primed +25% rate of fire and +30% weapon damage rewards players who rotate weapons instead of holding one trigger. pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Exotics / Backfire The Division 2 / Exotic SMG How to Get Backfire in The Division 2 Backfire is an exotic SMG that applies bleed to every target you hit and refills its magazine when you kill a bleeding enemy, creating satisfying kill chains. Unofficial fan guide by Raigulus. Last updated: September 11, 2026 Backfire at a Glance Type Exotic SMG Talent Payment in Kind Source Targeted Loot (SMG), Exotic Caches How to Unlock It Backfire drops from any activity that awards exotic items, with targeted SMG loot sources providing the best farming efficiency. Run Countdown with SMG targeting, clear Summit floors with SMG directives, or open Exotic Caches from weekly projects. It has a standard exotic drop rate and can appear from any source that awards exotic items. Payment in Kind, Explained Payment in Kind causes every bullet you fire to apply a bleed effect to the target. When you kill an enemy that is currently bleeding, your magazine instantly refills to full. This creates a powerful gameplay loop where you spread bleed across multiple targets and then chain kills by eliminating bleeding enemies. The talent rewards aggressive play and target prioritization. Build Tips Backfire synergizes exceptionally well with Eclipse Protocol, which spreads status effects on kill. When you kill a bleeding enemy, Eclipse spreads the bleed to nearby targets, creating chain reactions. Alternatively, run it with Hunter's Fury for close-quarters bleed builds that disorient and damage enemies simultaneously. For full setups see tested Division 2 builds . FAQ Does Payment in Kind apply bleed to all enemies? Yes, every bullet from Backfire applies a bleed effect to the target. Killing a bleeding enemy instantly refills your magazine, letting you chain kills without reloading. Can Backfire damage myself with bleed? No, Payment in Kind only applies bleed to enemies. You do not take any bleed damage from using Backfire. How does Backfire synergize with Eclipse Protocol? Eclipse Protocol spreads status effects on kill. Since Backfire applies bleed, killing a bleeding enemy spreads the bleed to nearby targets, creating chain reactions of damage. pages.t: How to Get Bullet King in Division 2 [2026]
pages.d: Find out how to get the Bullet King exotic LMG in The Division 2. Learn about its Bullet Hell talent that eliminates reloading for non-stop firepower.
pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Exotics / Bullet King The Division 2 / Exotic LMG How to Get Bullet King in The Division 2 The Bullet King is an exotic LMG that never needs to reload, giving you unlimited sustained firepower against any enemy. Unofficial fan guide by Raigulus. Last updated: September 11, 2026 Bullet King at a Glance Type Exotic LMG Talent Bullet Hell Source Rikers named boss drops, Targeted Loot (LMG) How to Unlock It Bullet King drops from Rikers faction named bosses throughout the open world and in missions. You can farm it by running LMG targeted loot activities, focusing on Control Points and territory controls controlled by Rikers. The Capitol Building stronghold and Wall Street mission are particularly efficient farming spots due to their high density of named enemies. Bullet Hell, Explained Bullet Hell removes the reload mechanic entirely from Bullet King. Your magazine never depletes, meaning you can hold down the trigger indefinitely as long as you have reserve ammunition. The trade-off is a slightly lower base damage compared to other exotic LMGs, but the zero downtime more than compensates in prolonged engagements where every reload animation would cost you precious DPS. Build Tips Bullet King excels in sustained DPS builds where consistent damage output matters more than burst. The Striker gear set amplifies your rate of fire and stacking damage, creating a lethal combination with zero reload downtime. Pair it with the Gunner specialization for ammo regeneration and rate of fire buffs on kills. The Coyote's Mask and Ceska Vyroba pieces boost critical hit chance for even more consistent damage. For full setups see tested Division 2 builds . FAQ Does Bullet King have infinite ammo? Bullet King doesn't have infinite ammo, but it never needs to reload. Your magazine never empties, so you can fire continuously as long as you have reserve ammunition. This makes it ideal for sustained DPS situations where reload downtime would normally cost you damage. What is the best specialization for Bullet King? The Gunner specialization is ideal for Bullet King. The Gunner's rate of fire buff on kills stacks perfectly with sustained fire, and the ammo regeneration passive ensures you never run dry. The Banshee Pulse also provides crowd control while you keep shooting. Can Bullet King drop from Dark Zone? Yes, Bullet King can drop from Rikers named boss encounters and targeted LMG loot in both PvE and Dark Zone activities. Farming Rikers Control Points and missions with LMG targeted loot gives you the best odds. Was this guide helpful? 👍 Yes 👎 No Discuss this guide with other players on Discord or send feedback . pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Exotics / Capacitor The Division 2 / Exotic Assault Rifle How to Get Capacitor in The Division 2 Capacitor is an exotic assault rifle that rewards hybrid skill builds with bonus weapon damage per Skill Tier and stacking skill damage on hit. Unofficial fan guide by Raigulus. Last updated: September 11, 2026 Capacitor at a Glance Type Exotic Assault Rifle Talent Capacitance Source Summit Challenges (5 completions), then Targeted Loot (AR) How to Unlock It Before Capacitor can drop, you need to complete 5 challenges in the Summit. These can be any difficulty and are designed to be achievable even for newer agents. Once completed, Capacitor drops from targeted assault rifle loot in Countdown, Summit, or any activity with AR loot. Exotic Caches also have a chance to award it. Capacitance, Explained Capacitance provides two distinct bonuses. First, you gain +5% weapon damage for each Skill Tier you have invested in, meaning a full Skill Tier 6 build grants a 30% weapon damage boost. Second, each time you shoot an enemy, you build stacks that grant +2.5% skill damage per stack, up to a maximum. This dual scaling makes Capacitor uniquely powerful in hybrid setups where you want both gunplay and skills to hit hard. Build Tips Capacitor excels in hybrid builds that split between Skill Tier and red core attributes. The Electric Glide exotic chest piece synergizes perfectly by boosting skill efficiency while you maintain weapon damage. Combine with Memento backpack for additional scaling across all three stat categories. For full setups see tested Division 2 builds . FAQ Do I need to complete Summit challenges first? Yes, you must complete 5 Summit challenges before Capacitor can drop from any source. These challenges are straightforward and can be done on lower difficulties. How much weapon damage does Capacitance give per Skill Tier? Capacitance grants +5% weapon damage for each Skill Tier you have. At Skill Tier 6, that is a 30% total weapon damage bonus. Can Capacitor be recalibrated? Capacitor can have one attribute recalibrated, but its talent is fixed. The skill damage stacking makes it a top-tier choice for hybrid builds. pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Exotics / Collector The Division 2 / Exotic Chest How to Get Collector in Division 2 [2026] Collector is an exotic chest piece that increases your loot drops, making it the ultimate farming accessory in The Division 2. Its Hoarder talent gives every kill a chance at bonus items. Unofficial fan guide by Raigulus. Last updated: September 11, 2026 Collector at a Glance Type Exotic Chest Talent Hoarder Source Exotic Cache (random) How to Unlock It Collector is obtained randomly from Exotic Caches, which are the only source for this chest piece. You earn Exotic Caches by completing weekly SHD level projects, reaching milestones on the season pass, clearing Summit floor 100, defeating the Nemesis in Descent, and from certain manhunt rewards. Since the drop is random, expect to open multiple Exotic Caches before Collector appears. Hoarder, Explained Hoarder gives every kill you make a 10% chance to drop an additional loot item on top of the normal drop. The bonus item can be any rarity, including high-end, gear set, or even exotic items. This effect has no internal cooldown, so rapid kills in missions or the open world can trigger multiple extra drops in quick succession, significantly boosting your loot per hour. Build Tips Collector is designed for loot farming builds rather than combat optimization. Pair it with gear that boosts kill speed like Negotiator's Dilemma or Striker to maximize the number of kills and therefore the number of bonus loot rolls. Use it when running Targeted Loot missions or farming open-world bosses to accelerate your gear acquisition. For full setups see tested Division 2 builds . FAQ How does the Hoarder talent work on Collector? Hoarder gives each kill a 10% chance to drop an extra loot item. This additional drop can be any rarity including high-end or exotic items, making Collector a top choice for agents focused on farming gear and maximizing loot efficiency. Where does Collector drop in Division 2? Collector is obtained randomly from Exotic Caches. You earn Exotic Caches through weekly SHD level projects, season pass rewards, Summit floor 100 completions, and Descent Nemesis kills. There is no targeted farming method since it only comes from Exotic Caches. Is Collector worth using in Division 2 endgame? Collector is primarily a loot farming tool rather than a combat-focused exotic. Its Hoarder talent increases your loot intake over time, helping you acquire god-roll items faster. For pure combat performance, other chest pieces like Tardigrade or Ridgeway's Pride offer more direct combat benefits. pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Exotics / Eagle Bearer The Division 2 / Exotic Assault Rifle How to Get Eagle Bearer in The Division 2 Eagle Bearer is a legendary raid-exclusive exotic assault rifle featuring the Tenacity talent that splits incoming damage and grants devastating headshot buffs. Unofficial fan guide by Raigulus. Last updated: September 11, 2026 Eagle Bearer at a Glance Type Exotic Assault Rifle Talent Tenacity Source Dark Hours Raid (weekly lockout) How to Unlock It Eagle Bearer drops exclusively from the Dark Hours raid, the first 8-player raid introduced in The Division 2. The drop is RNG-based and each character can only attempt it once per week due to the raid lockout. Assemble a competent 8-player group, learn the boss mechanics, and run it weekly for the best chance. Multiple characters increase your odds since each gets a separate weekly attempt. Tenacity, Explained Tenacity fundamentally changes how you take damage. Instead of receiving the full hit instantly, you absorb 50% immediately and the remaining 50% is dealt as a bleed effect over 10 seconds. This effectively gives you a second chance to heal or kill the source before the full damage lands. Headshot kills during this window grant a +35% damage buff that lasts 10 seconds, rewarding aggressive precision play. Build Tips Eagle Bearer is a powerhouse in both PVP and PVE DPS builds. The damage buff from headshot kills stacks with other damage multipliers, making it lethal in skilled hands. Negotiator's Dilemma pairs well since it spreads damage to marked targets while you fish for headshot kills. In PVP, the Tenacity bleed delay can bait opponents into overcommitting. For full setups see tested Division 2 builds . FAQ Is Eagle Bearer still raid-locked? Yes, Eagle Bearer only drops from the Dark Hours raid. There is no alternative acquisition method, and the raid has a weekly lockout per character. How does Tenacity handle incoming damage? Tenacity causes you to receive 50% of damage immediately while the remaining 50% is dealt as bleed over 10 seconds. This effectively lets you survive burst damage that would otherwise kill you. Can I farm Eagle Bearer with multiple characters? Yes, each of your characters can complete the Dark Hours raid once per week for a chance at Eagle Bearer. Running with 4 characters maximizes your weekly attempts. Was this guide helpful? 👍 Yes 👎 No Discuss this guide with other players on Discord or send feedback . Comments

pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Exotics / Iron Lung The Division 2 / Exotic LMG How to Get Iron Lung in The Division 2 The Iron Lung is an exotic LMG that heats up as you fire, eventually igniting enemies in a sustained burn that keeps them writhing in flames. Unofficial fan guide by Raigulus. Last updated: September 11, 2026 Iron Lung at a Glance Type Exotic LMG Talent Ardent Source Targeted Loot (LMG), Exotic Caches How to Unlock It Iron Lung drops from any activity with LMG targeted loot, including missions, control points, and open world activities. Exotic Caches from weekly SHD projects and season pass rewards are another reliable source. The weapon has a chance to drop from any exotic cache, so completing your weekly projects consistently will eventually yield one. Ardent, Explained Sustained fire fills a heat meter worth half the magazine; when it maxes out, your rounds ignite enemies. Stop shooting and the meter bleeds off — reload or swap weapons and it empties completely. So the playstyle is commitment: hold the trigger through the heat-up, never reload mid-fight, and let the burn do the talking against elites and bosses. Build Tips Iron Lung thrives in fire-based builds that amplify burn damage. The Firewall specialization provides a direct burn damage bonus and the Immolator chem launcher for spreading fire to additional targets. Equip the Vile mask for an extra damage-over-time layer and the Eclipse Protocol gear set to spread burn effects on kills. For full setups see tested Division 2 builds . FAQ How does the Ardent heat meter work? Firing fills a meter worth half the magazine; a full meter ignites enemies. Pausing drains it, and reloading or swapping empties it — so hold the trigger and never reload mid-fight. Does Iron Lung work with Firewall specialization? Iron Lung synergizes perfectly with the Firewall specialization. The Firewall's burn damage bonus amplifies the Ardent talent's burn ticks, and the flamethrower alt-weapon lets you ignite groups while keeping Iron Lung's burn active on priority targets. What is the best way to farm Iron Lung? Iron Lung drops from targeted LMG activities and Exotic Caches. Farm missions and strongholds with LMG targeted loot, or complete weekly projects that reward exotic caches. The Capitol Building and Roosevelt Island strongholds are efficient farming locations. Unofficial fan guide by Raigulus. Last updated: September 11, 2026 Oxpecker at a Glance Type Exotic SMG Talent Symbiosis Source Y6S3 Season Track (Rank 69), Targeted Loot (SMG) How to Unlock It Oxpecker was initially available as a guaranteed reward at Rank 69 on the Year 6 Season 3 track. After the season ended, it entered the general loot pool and can now drop from any targeted SMG source. Run Countdown with SMG targeting, clear Summit floors with SMG directives, or open Exotic Caches for a chance to obtain it. Symbiosis, Explained Symbiosis provides passive healing to all allies within 20 meters when you kill an enemy. Each kill grants +4% repair for 10 seconds, and the effect stacks up to 10 times. At maximum stacks, you are providing significant passive healing to your entire group just by getting kills. This makes Oxpecker uniquely valuable in group compositions where the healer also wants to contribute damage. Build Tips Oxpecker works best in support or crowd control builds that stay near teammates while dealing damage. A healing hybrid build that splits between skill tier and red cores lets you contribute both damage and sustained healing through Symbiosis. Pair it with a Tank or CC build to create a self-sustaining group that doesn't rely on a dedicated healer. For full setups see tested Division 2 builds . FAQ Can I still get Oxpecker after the season ends? Yes, Oxpecker can drop from targeted SMG loot sources after the season ends. The Season Track at Rank 69 was the initial guaranteed source, but it enters the general loot pool afterward. How much healing does Symbiosis provide? Each kill grants +4% repair to all allies within 20 meters for 10 seconds. This stacks up to 10 times for a maximum 40% heal per stack tick to nearby allies. Does Oxpecker heal myself too? Yes, Symbiosis heals all allies within 20 meters, including yourself. You benefit from your own kill stacks just like your teammates do. pages.t: How to Get Pestilence in Division 2 [2026]
pages.d: Learn how to get the Pestilence exotic LMG in The Division 2. Discover its Plague of the Outcasts talent and best builds for damage-over-time gameplay.
pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Exotics / Pestilence The Division 2 / Exotic LMG How to Get Pestilence in The Division 2 The Pestilence is an exotic LMG that applies a deadly plague debuff to enemies, dealing damage over time and spreading to nearby targets when infected hostiles die. Unofficial fan guide by Raigulus. Last updated: September 11, 2026 Pestilence at a Glance Type Exotic LMG Talent Plague of the Outcasts Source Targeted Loot (LMG), Dark Zone drops How to Unlock It Pestilence can drop from any LMG targeted loot activity, making it farmable in missions, strongholds, and open world activities. Dark Zone named bosses and contaminated loot also have a chance to drop it, though you'll need to extract safely. Exotic Caches from weekly projects and the Season Pass are another reliable source if RNG isn't on your side. Plague of the Outcasts, Explained When you hit an enemy with Pestilence, they receive the Plague debuff which ticks for weapon damage over 10 seconds. If the debuffed enemy dies, the plague spreads to all nearby enemies within a 15-meter radius, refreshing the duration. This makes Pestilence devastating against clustered NPC groups, as each kill triggers a chain reaction that can wipe entire packs without additional shots. Build Tips Pestilence shines in damage-over-time and status effect builds. Pair it with the Eclipse Protocol gear set to amplify the plague spread, or combine it with the Vile mask for an extra DoT layer. Coyote's Mask and Grupo Sombra pieces boost critical hit damage for hybrid setups. The Firewall specialization's burn synergies complement the fire-and-forget playstyle perfectly. For full setups see tested Division 2 builds . FAQ What is the best build for Pestilence in Division 2? Pestilence works best in DoT and status effect builds. Pair it with Eclipse Protocol gear set to spread the Plague debuff to nearby enemies, or use it with Coyote's Mask and Grupo Sombra pieces for hybrid DPS and burn damage. Does Pestilence work with Firewall specialization? Yes, Pestilence pairs exceptionally well with the Firewall specialization. The Firewall's striker drone and burn bonus amplify the damage-over-time effects, and the flamethrower alt-weapon synergizes with the DoT playstyle. Can Pestilence drop from the Dark Zone? Yes, Pestilence can drop from Dark Zone contaminated loot and named bosses. Running targeted LMG drops in the Dark Zone increases your chances, though PvP risk is a factor. pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Exotics / Sacrum Imperium The Division 2 / Exotic MMR How to Get Sacrum Imperium in Division 2 [2026] Sacrum Imperium exotic MMR tags targets through the scope: a headshot kill on a marked enemy ignites it and slows everything nearby. Last updated: September 11, 2026 Sacrum Imperium at a Glance Type Exotic MMR Talent The Trap Source Targeted Loot (MMR), Exotic Caches How to Unlock It Sacrum Imperium drops randomly from targeted loot MMR areas and exotic caches. Prioritize accuracy and headshot damage to secure the marked headshot kill, then let The Trap's burn and slow control the group. In group play, the slow sets up teammates' pushes. For full setups see tested Division 2 builds . FAQ How does The Trap talent work? Scope-tag up to ten enemies, then a headshot kill on a marked target burns it and slows nearby enemies. More headshots recharge it faster. Where does Sacrum Imperium drop? Sacrum Imperium drops from targeted loot MMR areas and exotic caches. There is no quest chain required — it is a random exotic drop from any eligible source. What makes Sacrum Imperium unique among MMRs? Sacrum Imperium is the only MMR that tags through the scope and pays off with burn plus crowd slow. The Trap rewards patient aim over spray. pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Exotics / Steel and Sons ACR The Division 2 / Exotic Rifle How to Get Steel & Sons ACR in Division 2 [2026] Steel & Sons ACR is the exotic rifle reward from the Broken Rain Incursion. First teased simply as the exotic ACR before its full Steel & Sons name was revealed. Its Confirm and Execute talent stacks amplified damage on body shots and cashes out on headshots, rewarding disciplined aim at long range. Unofficial fan guide by Raigulus. Last updated: September 20, 2026 Steel & Sons ACR at a Glance Type Exotic Rifle (ACR) Talent Confirm and Execute Source Broken Rain Incursion reward How to Unlock It Steel & Sons ACR is a reward from the Broken Rain Incursion. Clear the incursion with a squad - see the Broken Rain Incursion guide for boss mechanics and the Day One clear. The incursion key chest resets weekly, so plan repeat clears around the reset. Confirm and Execute, Explained Body shots add one stack to the enemy for 10 seconds, up to 4 stacks, and each stack gives +4% amplified damage. Hitting a different enemy removes all stacks, so stay on target. Your next headshot consumes all stacks for +11% amplified damage per stack. Destroying an enemy weakpoint makes them take +30% amplified damage from you for 5 seconds, which pairs perfectly with the cash-out headshot. Build Tips The ACR runs at 420 RPM with a 45m optimal range and 60% headshot damage, so it plays like a precision rifle with a rifle magazine. Stack rifle damage and critical-hit damage - the rifle cores come fixed on the weapon. Aim for weakpoints first for the +30% window, build 4 stacks, then cash out with a headshot. For full setups see tested Division 2 builds . FAQ How do I get the Steel and Sons ACR in Division 2? The Steel and Sons ACR is a reward from the Broken Rain Incursion. Clear the incursion with a squad to earn it, then check the Broken Rain guide for boss mechanics. How does Confirm and Execute work on the Steel and Sons ACR? Body shots add one stack for 10 seconds up to 4 stacks. Each stack gives +4% amplified damage. Your next headshot consumes all stacks for +11% amplified damage per stack. Destroying a weakpoint adds +30% amplified damage for 5 seconds. Is the Steel and Sons ACR good? Yes for disciplined aim. Its 45m optimal range and 60% headshot damage reward stack-then-headshot play, and the weakpoint bonus punishes bosses with exposed weakpoints. Tardigrade Armor System drops from True Sons named bosses in the open world and missions. You can also get it from Targeted Loot when Chest is the targeted slot, or from Exotic Caches. pages.t: Division 2 Broken Wings: Y5S1 Summary [2023]
pages.d: Division 2 Broken Wings (Y5S1) update summary: Mari Singh rescue manhunt, Descent rogue-lite mode, St. Elmo's Engine and Cavalier in our own words.
pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Broken Wings The Division 2 / Y5S1 Update Division 2 Broken Wings Update Guide Year 5 Season 1 launched on June 8, 2023 with a twist nobody expected: the manhunt targets are civilians to rescue, not rogues to hunt. Plus a brand-new rogue-lite mode anyone can play. Our plain-language summary below — full texts live on Ubisoft's news hub . Last updated: September 11, 2026 · Covers launch patch Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. Rescue Manhunt Instead of chasing rogue agents, you pull hostages out of Black Tusk hands: John Yazzie, Eva Garcia, Lauren Fong and Mitchell Billings first, then ex-aquarium director Mari Singh from the zoo. Every rescue feeds the Castle settlement rebuild while Natalya Sokolova plays power politics in the background. Target order on our manhunts hub . Descent Mode A free 1-to-4 player rogue-lite with no expansion gate: you drop into a high-tech bunker simulation stripped of gear and SHD tech, then draft weapons, skills and talents floor by floor against an endlessly scaling curve. My solo run reaching Nemesis with nothing is on the channel — perfect first taste before the weekly push. Mode notes live on our Escalation hub . New Loot St. Elmo's Engine (Exotic AR) Actum Est: hits stack up, and at a full hundred your next magazine fires shock rounds. Shocker Punch (Exotic Holster) Defibrillator: shrugs off electric stuns faster and turns shields and melee into shock delivery — paired with Elmo's it hits even harder on a short cooldown. Cavalier (Set) Out-of-cover survival set: hazard protection and incoming repairs that charge into team-wide damage sharing at full power. Electrique (Brand) Crowd-control brand whose backpack converts your disables into shared bonus armor for the whole squad. Cabaret / Big Show Named MP5 and MG5 for close-quarters and sustained-fire roles. Season Flavor A Splinter Cell outfit headlines the season pass, with SHD and Black Tusk vanity arriving in the mid-season apparel event. FAQ When did Broken Wings launch? Year 5 Season 1 launched on June 8, 2023, opening with a rescue-style manhunt and the free Descent rogue-lite mode. Do you need the expansion to play Descent? No. Descent is free for all players and does not require Warlords of New York ownership, unlike the seasonal manhunt track. pages.t: Division 2 Concealed Agenda: Y1S3 Summary [2020]
pages.d: Division 2 Concealed Agenda (Y1S3) update summary: Schaeffer manhunt, The Summit, Backfire, Hunter's Fury and transmog in our own words.
pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Concealed Agenda The Division 2 / Y1S3 Update Division 2 Concealed Agenda Update Guide Year 1 Season 3 launched on September 22, 2020 with Title Update 11 — the patch that gave us a 100-floor skyscraper and finally let agents dress how they want. Our plain-language summary below — full texts live on Ubisoft's news hub . Last updated: September 11, 2026 · Covers launch patch Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. Schaeffer Manhunt Prime target Bardon Schaeffer runs the Black Tusk's BTSU ghost unit through four rogue lieutenants — Shade, Wraith, Dusk and Belfry. The finale at Coney Island flips the table: Schaeffer fights beside a Hunter, and Sokolova herself phones in mid-fight. Clearing all five unlocks the Shrapnel Trap skill variant. Target order on our manhunts hub — and our channel has a Tier 10 run through the very same amusement park. The Summit Solo or up to four players climb a faction-held high-rise across 100 scaling floors with checkpoints every ten. Full clear pays the Ridgeway's Pride exotic chest. Later patches added selectable difficulty, directives and targeted loot — it remains the game's gear-set supermarket. New Loot Backfire (Exotic SMG) Damage climbs relentlessly — but every reload makes you bleed for it. High risk, high reward in one magazine. Ridgeway's Pride (Exotic Chest) Bleed-powered sustain that grows stronger per bleeding enemy. Summit full-clear prize. Hunter's Fury (Set) Close-quarters set for SMGs and shotguns that cripples whatever crowds you. Belstone Armory (Brand) Tank sustain brand: armor regen, armor-on-kill and incoming repairs. Transmog & Discovery Appearance Mods finally separated looks from stats for every player, agnostic mod slots opened up, and Iron Horse got a Discovery mode so everyone can see the raid. Clearing all 100 floors awards the Ridgeway's Pride exotic chest, a self-sustaining bleed piece that scales with bleeding enemies. pages.t: Division 2 Crossroads Update Guide: Y7 Brooklyn DLC [2025]
pages.d: Division 2 Crossroads (Y7) update summary: Battle for Brooklyn DLC, Schaefer manhunt, Seasonal Journey revamp, Bighorn, Tinkerer Mask and new Hunters.
pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Crossroads The Division 2 / Y7 Update Division 2 Crossroads Update Guide Year 7 launched on May 27, 2025 with two tracks side by side: the paid Battle for Brooklyn map DLC and the free Crossroads season. Our plain-language summary below — full texts live on Ubisoft's news hub . Last updated: September 10, 2026 · Covers Y7 launch Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. Brooklyn DLC (Paid) The first new open-world zone since 2020: autumn Brooklyn with Dumbo and Brooklyn Heights districts, 4 control points, 12 activities, 10 bounties and 8 Hunter puzzles with unique masks. DLC owners also gained 50 extra stash slots. Brooklyn control points fight back harder than elsewhere — fortified defenses scale with difficulty, and clearing linked activities raises the point's level instead of lowering it. Crossroads Season (Free) Barton Schaefer wakes from his coma with Black Tusk secrets, driving an 11-scout manhunt that ends in a Climax Mission awarding the Tinkerer exotic mask. The Seasonal Journey was rebuilt for co-op: squadmates' progress counts, missions unlock in parallel, and rewards include caches plus the Measured Assembly set blueprints. New Loot Bighorn (Exotic AR) Big Game Hunter: scoping switches to semi-auto 450% shots, headshots stack bonus damage to 50. Legendary Strongholds and Summit only. Nimble Holster Cover-to-cover healing talent returns from the first game. Tinkerer (Exotic Mask) Climax Mission reward; shares weapon talents between same-class weapons. Measured Assembly (Set) Seasonal Journey blueprints; Nod to the classic Final Measure set. Systems & QoL Mobile Cover returned as a skill, scavenging resources merged into one account-wide pool (old stockpiles were converted), the game joined Game Pass on launch day, and onboarding plus stash improvements targeted returning players. What This Means for Builds Brooklyn Hunters demand puzzle-solving plus burst damage — test mask-farm loadouts in the build planner and run current content in today's targeted loot . FAQ When did Crossroads launch? Year 7 launched on May 27, 2025 with the paid Battle for Brooklyn DLC and the free Crossroads season side by side. What is the Crossroads manhunt reward? Clearing the scout chain unlocks the Climax Mission, which awards the Tinkerer exotic mask. Is Battle for Brooklyn free? No. The Brooklyn map zone is a paid DLC, while the Crossroads season track, manhunt and Journey revamp are free for all players. pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Dark Hours The Division 2 / Raid (TU3) Division 2 Dark Hours Guide Operation Dark Hours launched on May 16, 2019 as part of Title Update 3 — delayed three weeks past April so balance patches could land first. Bosses backed by the faction's best tech gate every hangar. Tactics live on our Incursions & Raids hub . Race to World First Launch morning opened with a broadcast race: the first clear team earned their photo and names on the White House wall, every finisher took a clan banner and trophy, and week-one clears added a commemorative patch. pages.d: Division 2 Hidden Alliance (Y4S1) update summary: Captain Lewis manhunt, Countdown mode, Expertise, Dread Edict and Heartbreaker in our own words.
pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Hidden Alliance The Division 2 / Y4S1 Update Division 2 Hidden Alliance Update Guide Year 4 Season 1 launched on May 12, 2022 in the shadow of Camp White Oak — with Faye Lau gone, her encrypted comms hinting she was undercover all along, and the True Sons mutating under new leadership. This season also rewrote how manhunts tell stories. Our plain-language summary below — full texts live on Ubisoft's news hub . Last updated: September 11, 2026 · Covers launch patch Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. Lewis Manhunt Prime target Captain Lewis marches on D.C. with his own agenda while Ridgeway's death fractures the True Sons into zealots and opportunists. Four officers — Castilla, Chang, Daniels and Xander — each seize a campaign mission as their turf. Kelso now debriefs you in person at the White House so no story beat gets lost. Target order on our manhunts hub . Countdown & Expertise The season's quiet giants launched here, not next season: the 8-player Countdown power-plant run, and the Expertise system that lets you permanently upgrade favorite weapons and gear by using them. Both outlived every season around them. New Loot Dread Edict (Exotic MMR) Full Stop: body shots stack damage up to twenty, headshots double-stack, and reloading converts the pile into temporary armor — headshot kills skip the reload entirely. Catharsis (Exotic Mask) Vicious Cycle: eating damage charges you up, and maxing out purges everything into a healing cloud for the squad. Bluescreen (Exotic LMG) Disruptor Rounds: paint enemies to bank stacks up to fifty. Blueprint from the Lewis manhunt, refills from Countdown LMG loot — our channel build shows the playstyle. Heartbreaker (Set) Headshots pulse victims while follow-up hits stack bonus armor and damage up to fifty — double with chest and backpack. Uzina Getica (Brand) Tanky brand with flat armor, armor-on-kill and hazard protection. Storytelling Shift Cinematics, Base of Operations debriefs and mission-takeover lieutenants made this the first season that plays like episodes — the template every later season copied. FAQ When did Hidden Alliance launch? Year 4 Season 1 launched on May 12, 2022, picking up right after the Camp White Oak showdown with Faye Lau. How do you get the Bluescreen exotic LMG? Finish the Captain Lewis manhunt for the blueprint, then farm Countdown with LMG targeted loot for more rolls. pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Into the Dark The Division 2 / Y8S2 Update Division 2 Into the Dark Update Guide Year 8 Season 2 launched on June 16, 2026 (patch 2.29) and rebuilt the Dark Zone around three rotating variants, with a Toxicity-driven seasonal loop, healer loot, and the first phase of a PvP rebalance. Our plain-language summary below — full texts live on Ubisoft's news hub . Last updated: September 10, 2026 · Covers launch patch Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. Three Dark Zones Classic The baseline PvPvE experience: normalization, SHD Watch, Expertise, Rogue protocol and invasions all active. Toxic (PvE) Cooperative seasonal loop, no player-vs-player damage, Rogue protocol off. Contamination and Toxicity replace the paranoia. Balanced Competitive PvPvE on the Conflict ruleset with high-level normalization; SHD Watch and Expertise disabled. Toxicity, Surge & Samples The seasonal loop runs on Sample Cannisters pulled from landmarks (extract them like contaminated loot). Samples feed the Surge system, which supercharges active modifiers — Invincible for healing and armor, Pneuma for weapon handling, Vicarious for skill support — plus nine passives across gadgets, resistances and offense. Enemy-side pressure comes from Folie à Deux, Plague Doctor and Soporific modifiers, several of which also raise your Toxicity meter. New Loot Caduceus (Exotic AR) Crits repair you and nearby allies for 3% of damage dealt; ships with crit chance, 40-round mag and crit damage mods. Nurse's Kneepads Impervious: +40% hazard protection for you and allies within 10 meters. Ortiz: Reficere (Set) Healer set: 8% skill efficiency, 60% repair skills, and a 4-piece that trades duration and range for +150% healing. Edelweiss GPz (Brand) Repair-focused brand: repair skills, skill haste and skill efficiency across its bonuses. Underboss (Exotic SMG) Added to the season gear cache with a crit-chance optic. PvP & Escalation Notes Phase one of the PvP rebalance retuned weapon and gear talents to close the gap between meta and off-meta picks, with skills and attributes queued for later phases. Escalation gained Hyena ambushes during Retaliation, DZ vendors were overhauled with new caches, and entrance turrets plus spawn protection made door camping harder. What This Means for Builds Healer builds became first-class citizens again — test Caduceus plus Ortiz: Reficere combos in the build planner , and watch the toxic-zone farming loop in Dark Zone Surge . FAQ When did Into the Dark launch? Year 8 Season 2 launched on June 16, 2026 with patch 2.29, rebuilding the Dark Zone around three rotating variants. What is the Toxic Dark Zone? A PvE-focused Dark Zone variant where agents cooperate under Toxicity pressure instead of fighting each other, with Rogue protocol disabled. Which exotics came with Into the Dark? The Caduceus exotic assault rifle, the Underboss exotic SMG in the season gear cache, plus the Ortiz Reficere healer gear set and Edelweiss GPz brand. pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Keener's Legacy The Division 2 / Y1S2 Update Division 2 Keener's Legacy Update Guide Year 1 Season 2 launched on June 23, 2020 with Title Update 10 — the season the original villain stepped out of the shadows himself, and a True Sons foundry became the game's second raid. Our plain-language summary below — full texts live on Ubisoft's news hub . Last updated: September 11, 2026 · Covers launch patch Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. Keener Manhunt Prime target Aaron Keener splintered the story across five lieutenants — Hornet, Termite, Luna, Huntsman and Titan — each lending their name to a league. Clearing all five unlocks the Healing Trap skill variant. Target order on our manhunts hub . Operation Iron Horse The True Sons seized a foundry to build weapons of mass disruption, and eight agents answer. Two raid-exclusive exotics wait inside: the double-barrel Ravenous that swaps primers per shoulder, and the Regulus magnum turning headshot kills into five-meter explosions. Full raid notes on our Incursions & Raids hub . New Loot Regulus (Exotic Pistol) Headshot kills detonate for massive area damage with bleed — Iron Horse exclusive, still a PvP icon. The Ravenous (Exotic Rifle) Shoulder-swapped primers make every trigger pull a decision. Iron Horse exclusive. Mantis (Exotic MMR) Scope intel on unaware enemies with highlighted weak points. Vile (Exotic Mask) Status-spreading mask for crowd-melting builds. Eclipse Protocol (Set) The status set: spread, prolong and weaponize every effect. Walker, Harris & Co. (Brand) Straight damage brand: weapon, armor and health damage tiers. Rebalance Pass The season's quiet giant: nearly every weapon, most gear, NPCs and crowd-control got retuned for game health, loot generosity and player power — the first of the great rebalance eras. FAQ When did Keener's Legacy launch? Year 1 Season 2 launched on June 23, 2020 alongside Title Update 10, with Aaron Keener himself as prime target. How do you get the Regulus exotic pistol? Regulus drops exclusively from the Operation Iron Horse raid, rewarding headshot kills with explosive blasts. pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Mutiny The Division 2 / Y7S3 Update Division 2 Mutiny Update Guide Year 7 Season 3 launched on December 2, 2025 (patch 2.15) as True Sons defectors broke ranks against General Anderson — and for the first time you can recruit them as NPC Companions fighting beside you. Our plain-language summary below — full texts live on Ubisoft's news hub . Last updated: September 10, 2026 · Covers launch patch Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. NPC Companions & Command Link Defectors met in open-world encounters and Mutiny events can be recruited if they survive the fight. As squad leader you order them to reposition, focus targets, support the team or trigger abilities through the Command Link global talent, which pays out stacking buffs — crit damage, reload speed, weapon damage and bonus armor — plus link points per order type. New Commander, Jammer and Fireteam enemy behaviors exist specifically to break up that coordination. New Loot Bittersweet (Exotic MMR) Transfusion: headshots build 8 stacks, then healing an ally or skill turns all hits into guaranteed headshots for 8 seconds. Beacon (Exotic Chest) Bond: aura buffs for you and allies (or your skills) within 10 meters — crit damage, skill efficiency, armor regen. Sheriff (Exotic Shotgun) Guaranteed on the first Master Climax clear, farmable after that. Concentrated Company (Set) Teamwork set: mark enemies for stacking weapon and crit damage per contributing ally or skill. Unit Alloys (Brand) Rate of fire, assault rifle damage and magazine size bonuses. Equalizer / Salvo Named chest and holster with Perfect Obliterate and Perfect rate-of-fire rolls. What This Means for Builds Everything this season scales with allies — group members, NPCs, skills and your Companion all count. Test aura-stacking setups in the build planner and run current content in today's targeted loot . FAQ When did Mutiny launch? Year 7 Season 3 launched on December 2, 2025 with patch 2.15, adding recruitable NPC Companions. How do Companions work in Mutiny? Defected True Sons soldiers met in open-world encounters can be recruited, then ordered to move, focus targets, support or use abilities through Command Link. Which exotics came with Mutiny? The Bittersweet marksman rifle and Beacon chest through seasonal play, plus the Sheriff shotgun from the Master Climax Mission. pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Price of Power The Division 2 / Y4S2 Update Division 2 Price of Power Update Guide Year 4 Season 2 launched on September 13, 2022 with a power-hungry general stitching the True Sons and Black Tusk back together — while last season's Countdown mode matured into the game's best exotic farm. Our plain-language summary below — full texts live on Ubisoft's news hub . Last updated: September 11, 2026 · Covers launch patch Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. Anderson Manhunt Prime target General Peter Anderson wants Ridgeway's chair and a reunited True Sons–Black Tusk alliance strong enough to bury the Division. Stopping him means cutting through his officers first. Target order on our manhunts hub . Countdown Comes of Age Born last season in Hidden Alliance, the Pentco power-plant run found its identity here: two fireteams of four against the clock, difficulties for every level, its own requisition vendor — and targeted loot that turned it into the exotic farm. See what's hot on our loot hub . New Loot Doctor Home (Exotic Rifle) Marks a target per shot; the kill drops an armor kit that heals the whole squad on pickup. Blueprint from the Anderson manhunt, refills from Countdown rifle loot. Busy Little Bee (Exotic Pistol) Tag a different enemy per shot to stack damage, then swap weapons to cash the stacks in for ten seconds of pain. Umbra Initiative (Set) Cover-dance set: bank stacks while tucked in, spend them pushing forward — crit, reload speed and armor regen included. Brazos de Arcabuz (Brand) Skill builder's brand with haste, a free skill tier and bigger magazines. Bloody Knuckles (Exotic Gloves) Over the Top: grenade or melee openers trigger Seeing Red — bonus weapon and melee damage on a minute cooldown. Rebalances Ongoing Directive and Striker's Battlegear both got tuning passes in the same patch — the start of the long road to the modern DPS meta. FAQ When did Price of Power launch? Year 4 Season 2 launched on September 13, 2022, bringing new loot, rebalances and the hunt for General Peter Anderson. How does Countdown work? Two teams of four enter a power plant against the clock, clear two of three objectives to unlock the main goal, then survive a hunter-grade ambush on the way out. pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Puppeteers The Division 2 / Y5S2 Update Division 2 Puppeteers Update Guide Year 5 Season 2 launched on October 3, 2023 with agents hunting The Recruiter — and the headline act was the return of Incursions after a Division 1-era absence. Our plain-language summary below — full texts live on Ubisoft's news hub . Last updated: September 11, 2026 · Covers launch patch Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. The Recruiter Manhunt The seasonal trail runs through rescued civilians — Cindy and Jack McAllister, Mel Arnold and Vikram Malik — and ends at prime target Brian Johnson, better known as The Recruiter. See the full target order on our manhunts hub . Paradise Lost Incursion Four-player endgame with four encounters and two boss fights, tuned like a raid-lite: mechanics punish sloppy positioning and the final chest holds the season's chase item. Entry is free for all players with a weekly completion reward. Tactics and loadout notes live on our Incursions & Raids hub — including our flawless squad clear. New Loot Ouroboros (Exotic SMG) Rule Them All: suffering a status effect charges your next magazine to spread the same status. Paradise Lost final-chest exclusive, weekly chance. Iron Lung (Exotic LMG) Ardent: sustained fire fills a heat meter worth half a magazine, then rounds ignite enemies. Pausing cools it; reloading or swapping empties it. Collector (Exotic Chest) Hoarder: bigger grenade pouch, wider and harder blasts that scale per extra enemy caught, plus slow grenade regeneration under two held. Born Great / Grown Great Named G36 and Tommy Gun sharing Perfect Stabilize: accuracy and stability ramp per bullet fired, resetting seconds after you stop. Exuro (Set) Grenade-kill stacking set for demolition playstyles, joined by a new brand set and fresh weapon talents. Descent Tweak Mid-loop rewards improved: loop 15 now pays an Exotic Cache instead of a Simulation Cache, making deep Descent runs worth pushing weekly. FAQ When did Puppeteers launch? Year 5 Season 2 launched on October 3, 2023, sending agents after The Recruiter and bringing Incursions back to The Division 2. How do you get the Ouroboros exotic SMG? Ouroboros drops only from the Paradise Lost incursion, with a weekly shot at the final chest. Clear it once per week for the best odds. pages.d: Division 2 Red Horizon (Y8S3) update summary [2026]: new exotics, Determined rework, brand changes and Season Pass rewards in our own words.
pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Red Horizon Update The Division 2 / Y8S3 Update Division 2 Red Horizon Update Guide Year 8 Season 3 launched on August 27, 2026. The Cleaners push into Washington DC under a new global modifier, three exotics join the loot pool, and the Determined talent gets its biggest rework in years. Below is our plain-language summary — numbers are facts from the official notes, sentences are ours. Full texts: Ubisoft's Red Horizon news hub . Last updated: September 10, 2026 · Covers launch patch Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. Season Theme Cleaners bring fire to DC. The seasonal modifier fills a Pressure Gauge through kills and unlocks active modifiers that no longer share cooldowns. A first-ever non-normalized Dark Zone variant (Blackout) keeps SHD Watch and Expertise power intact. New Exotics Fafnir (Shotgun) Dragon's Breath: 40% Burn chance per shot, damage scales with half your Status bonus. Free Season Pass track. Fafnir guide Iron Will (Chest) Resolved: body shots count as headshots, 2s PvE / 3s PvP cooldown, MMR/Rifle/Pistol only. Free Season Pass track. Iron Will guide Loaded for Bear (Gloves) Afterburn: stacks up to 20 per target, reload converts them at 2% weapon damage each. Climax Mission exclusive. Loaded for Bear guide Determined Rework Determined now behaves like Perfect Determined: a converted headshot kill no longer chains into another guaranteed headshot. The old chaining playstyle moves to the Iron Will chest, which frees the weapon talent slot — the intended home is exotic MMRs and high-end MMRs with other talents. Marksman Rifle sets and brands (Hotshot, Aces & Eights, MMR damage bonuses) were buffed to compensate. Brand & Gear Set Changes Shock Resistance, Health, Incoming Repairs and Swap Speed leave brand bonuses; Protection from Elites joins. Each weapon type now has at least one brand offering its bonus at 1 piece and another at 2 pieces. Going forward there are no new brand sets — expect named pieces with perfect talents on existing brands instead. Red-core sets plus Ortiz: Exuro and True Patriot were rebalanced around risk versus reward. Season Pass at a Glance Free track carries both launch exotics plus caches, outfits and VFX. The $9.99 pass adds a second Fafnir copy, an exotic weapon skin, dyes, caches and premium credits. Full reward tables live on Ubisoft's announcement page linked above. What This Means for Builds Status-effect fire builds gain a real shotgun option, MMR builds rebuild around Iron Will instead of Determined, and glove slots stay open until the Climax Mission lands. Test combinations in the build planner and compare with tested builds . FAQ When did Red Horizon launch? Year 8 Season 3 launched on August 27, 2026, bringing the Cleaners to Washington DC with a new global modifier. What changed with Determined in Red Horizon? Determined now behaves like Perfect Determined, so chained headshots no longer retrigger. The old chaining moved to the Iron Will exotic chest. Which exotics are new in Red Horizon? Fafnir shotgun and Iron Will chest on the free Season Pass track, plus Loaded for Bear gloves as the Climax Mission exclusive. pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Reign of Fire The Division 2 / Y4S3 Update Division 2 Reign of Fire Update Guide Year 4 Season 3 launched on February 27, 2023 to close out Year 4 — with Sokolova stepping out of the shadows, Hunters stirring in the capital, and a bomb-maker to catch. Stovepipe Manhunt Prime target Zachary "Stovepipe" Beattie is a disposal specialist who started hoarding unstable device schematics until the Black Tusk recruited him. Four lieutenants — Chunks, Bantam, Cursed and Auntie — stand between you and his location. Meanwhile Captain Lewis's defectors join your side and a new recruit starts cracking Hunter drone files. Target order on our manhunts hub . New Loot Sacrum Imperium (Exotic MMR) The Trap: scope-tag up to ten targets, then a headshot kill on a marked one ignites it and slows everything nearby. Doctor Home (Rework) Armor kits from marked kills now fly straight to you instead of dropping at the target. PvP Notes Lower-tier agents get fairer Jammer play against high skill tiers, and source-locked exotics can now surface as contaminated DZ drops. FAQ When did Reign of Fire launch? Year 4 Season 3 launched on February 27, 2023, closing Year 4 with the hunt for bomb-maker Zachary Stovepipe Beattie. What makes the NinjaBike backpack special? Its talent counts toward any equipped gear or brand set bonus, letting you mix set bonuses that normally need full dedication. pages.t: Division 2 Rise Up: Y8S1 Summary [2026]
pages.d: Division 2 Rise Up (Y8S1) update summary [2026]: Escalation difficulty, Prototype rarity, Black Tusk Retaliation, Agitator and Investor exotics.
pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Rise Up The Division 2 / Y8S1 Update Division 2 Rise Up Update Guide Year 8 Season 1 launched in early April 2026 (patch 2.24) and raised the endgame ceiling: a new Escalation difficulty, a Prototype gear rarity, Black Tusk Retaliation events and the return of Classified Assignments. Our plain-language summary below — full texts live on Ubisoft's news hub . Last updated: September 10, 2026 · Covers launch + Y8S1.2 Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. Escalation Difficulty Escalation is a permanent endgame replay mode with 10 tiers, token-based entry and no checkpoints — fail the run and the wagered tokens are gone. Five missions and strongholds rotate every Tuesday, with seasonal mutators keeping the rotation fresh. Solo, group and matchmaking are all supported from level 40. Prototype Rarity Prototype sits above existing tiers with stat values up to roughly 1.5 times previous limits, plus an Augment system (over 30 passive modifiers) fed by Prototype Cores. Pieces drop in Escalation or upgrade from high-end, gear-set and named items — but Prototype power is limited in PvP, raids and incursions by design. New Loot Agitator (Exotic AR) Perturb talent: holster it to prime, swap back for rate-of-fire and weapon damage. Free Season Pass track. Investor (Exotic Mask) Attribute-driven exotic with a restricted roll pool. Free Season Pass track. Whiplash (Exotic Pistol) Guaranteed on the first Master Climax clear, farmable after that. Core Strength (Set) Core Exercise talent set built around weapon swapping. Robin / Bulldog Named chest and holster with Perfect Gunslinger and Perfect Composure. Retaliation & Modifiers Black Tusk Retaliation events fill an agitation meter through kills and activities, with Maneuver bonus objectives and rare Kill Squads — including the elite BTSU Team 9 — dropping blueprints for Climax, raid and Dark Zone exotics. The Recombinant global modifier plus the Back and Forth talent family reward swapping weapons mid-fight. Y8S1.2 Mid-Season Patch (May 12) The mid-season update added the Escalation Requisition Vendor (three Prototype caches for tokens), the Capitol Globe Anomaly classified assignment, Assault and Ambush global events, a Vanguard Overdrive multiplier week, and a long bug-fix list including Prototype sharing and Danny Weaver cache purchases. What This Means for Builds Weapon-swap talents made aggressive play pay — test Agitator pairings in the build planner and run the weekly set in Escalation Tier 10 . FAQ When did Rise Up launch? Year 8 Season 1 launched in early April 2026 with patch 2.24, adding the Escalation difficulty and Prototype rarity. What is Escalation in The Division 2? A permanent endgame difficulty with 10 tiers, token entry, no checkpoints and a weekly Tuesday rotation of five missions. Which exotics came with Rise Up? The Agitator assault rifle and Investor mask on the Season Pass track, plus the Whiplash pistol from the first Master Climax clear. pages.d: Division 2 Season 5-8 rerun years summary: Shadow Tide, Concealed Agenda, End of Watch and Keener's Legacy returns in our own words.
pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Season Reruns The Division 2 / Seasons 5-8 Division 2 Season Reruns Guide Through 2021 into early 2022 the game replayed its first four seasons in order instead of writing new ones — no new prime targets, no new loot, just second chances. One page covers all four, because four thin pages would serve nobody. Details on each original run live in their own guides, linked below. Last updated: September 11, 2026 · Covers S5-S8 reruns Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. The Rerun Order Season 5 — Shadow Tide Returns Jupiter's cell again: Neptune, Venus, Saturn, Mercury. See our Shadow Tide guide . Season 6 — Concealed Agenda Returns Schaeffer's BTSU cell again: Shade, Wraith, Dusk, Belfry. See our Concealed Agenda guide . Season 7 — End of Watch Returns Lau's rogues again: Viper, Kestrel, Magnus, Circe. See our End of Watch guide . Season 8 — Keener's Legacy Returns Keener's lieutenants again: Hornet, Termite, Luna, Huntsman, Titan. See our Keener's Legacy guide . Why It Matters Missed the EMP Sticky Bomb, the Shrapnel Trap or the Healing Trap the first time? The reruns were the catch-up window — and the quiet before Season 9's Hidden Alliance rebooted everything with Countdown and Expertise. FAQ Why did The Division 2 re-run old seasons? The team paused original seasons through 2021 into early 2022 while building the next era, replaying Seasons 1-4 as Seasons 5-8. Do rerun seasons have new rewards? No. Reruns replay the original manhunts, leagues and events, so veterans chase anything they missed and newcomers meet old prime targets. pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Shadow Tide The Division 2 / Y1S1 Update Division 2 Shadow Tide Update Guide Year 1 Season 1 ran from March 10 to June 15, 2020 — the experiment that invented the seasonal model: a 12-week track, leagues, global events, apparel event and one rogue cell to dismantle piece by piece. Our plain-language summary below — full texts live on Ubisoft's news hub . Last updated: September 11, 2026 · Covers launch patch Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. Jupiter Manhunt With Keener down and the Rogue Network lit, Molly "Jupiter" Henderson's cell plots to EMP the Division into the dark. Four lieutenants — Neptune, Venus, Mercury, plus Saturn hiding the New York safehouse — lead to a retaken Roosevelt Island held by boat-landed Cleaners. The finale hands you the EMP Sticky Bomb variant. Target order on our manhunts hub — and our channel holds a solo flawless of that very island. Seasonal Model Four leagues, three global events, the Urban Jungle apparel event and a season-level reward track: every structure later seasons reused was prototyped here. New Loot Tardigrade (Exotic Backpack) Full-armor emergency refill when your shell cracks — the original clutch backpack. Coyote's Mask (Exotic Mask) Pack Instincts: shares distance-based crit bonuses with the whole squad. Season 1 track reward. Firewall (Specialization) Flamethrower signature weapon with Striker Shield and cluster grenades for the up-close agent. FAQ When did Shadow Tide launch? Year 1 Season 1 ran from March 10 to June 15, 2020, introducing the seasonal model with the Jupiter manhunt. What do you unlock for finishing the Jupiter manhunt? Clearing all five rogue agents unlocks the EMP Sticky Bomb variant, recovered from Jupiter's jammer plot on Roosevelt Island. Our plain-language summary below — full texts live on Ubisoft's news hub . Last updated: September 10, 2026 · Covers launch patch Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. Retaliation Activity Retaliation triggers when a faction is sufficiently provoked: it marks a named zone and seizes every control point inside it. Retake them all before time runs out. Side Maneuver challenges buy extra time, Kill Squads raise the stakes, and an agitation meter per faction — pushed up by kills, missions and captures, or instantly by a daily project — decides who retaliates next. The mode stayed in the game permanently after the season. Exotic Crafting Retaliation materials (Hyena spice, Outcast canisters and equivalents) combine with Exotic Components to craft exotics, with better blueprint odds on higher difficulties. Full Retaliation clears can also yield raid and Dark Zone exotic blueprints. New Loot Shroud (Exotic MMR) Bonus damage against the highest-ranking enemy on the field. Craftable. Overdogs (Exotic Gloves) Weakest Link: +30% weapon damage against the lowest-ranking enemy tier. Craftable. Tempest (Exotic Pistol) Restrained: full-auto sidearm, +25% amplified damage for 20s after your shield breaks. Climax Mission loot, guaranteed on first Master clear. Tipping Scales (Set) LMG set: +30% mag size, +30% LMG damage, stacking handling and crit damage while firing. Urban Lookout (Brand) Marksman rifle damage brand. Achilles / Instigator Named weapons with Perfect Soft Spot: +32% weapon damage for 15s after destroying a weak point. Modifiers The Divide and Conquer global modifier ties combat power to map control — bonuses shift with whichever faction holds each named zone — backed by faction-flavored active modifiers that level up through use. FAQ When did The Pact launch? Year 7 Season 2 launched on September 9, 2025 with patch 2.10, adding the permanent Retaliation activity and exotic crafting. What is Retaliation in The Division 2? A permanent open-world activity where factions retaliate zone by zone. Retaking control points earns faction materials used to craft exotics. Which exotics came with The Pact? The Shroud marksman rifle and Overdogs gloves through crafting, plus the Tempest full-auto pistol from the Climax Mission. pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Title Update 9 The Division 2 / Title Update (TU9) Division 2 TU9 Guide Title Update 9 launched on April 21, 2020 — no new missions, no new season, just the single most-requested system since the expansion: your dusty level-30 exotics could finally grow up. Our plain-language summary below — full texts live on Ubisoft's news hub . Last updated: September 11, 2026 · Covers launch patch Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. Exotic Reconfiguration A new bench menu does two things: lifts any exotic to your bench level (cap 40), then re-rolls every attribute above a guaranteed minimum — god-rolls possible, downgrades possible. One exotic component plus materials per spin, blueprints from Inaya, old upgrade prints auto-converted. And the economy tightened the same day: deconstructions dropped from two components to one. Reworks & Buffs Diamondback (Rework) Mark a target, enjoy five seconds of guaranteed crits. The underperformer woke up. Sawyer's Kneepads (Rework) Explosion-proof stance that stacks damage the longer you hold still. Merciless / Ruthless (Buff) Explosion damage up by a third to compensate for non-scaling crits. Imperial Dynasty / Dodge City (Buff) Cooldowns cut for the brand-less exotics. Min-roll Floor All exotics now roll at the highest possible minimum regardless of source difficulty. TU9.1 Footnote Three weeks later (May 14) a tuning-only patch walked back overtuned NPC grenades, status effects and blindfire aim — the community's loudest post-TU9 complaint. FAQ When did Title Update 9 launch? Title Update 9 launched on April 21, 2020, introducing exotic reconfiguration at the crafting bench. Is reconfiguring a good exotic risky? Yes. Every attribute bar re-rolls above a guaranteed minimum, so a god-roll can come out weaker. Only gamble what you can afford to lose. pages.b: Home / The Division 2 / Patches / Warlords of New York The Division 2 / Expansion (TU8) Division 2 Warlords of New York Guide The expansion launched on March 3, 2020 as Title Update 8 — back to where it all began, hunting the First Rogue through a hurricane-hit Manhattan. It also rebooted the entire endgame underneath the campaign. Our plain-language summary below — full texts live on Ubisoft's news hub . Last updated: September 11, 2026 · Covers launch patch Unofficial fan summary. Game content belongs to Ubisoft; full texts linked above. Keener Campaign A bio-attack levels City Hall and the trail leads to Lower Manhattan: four rogue warlords — Theo Parnell, James Dragov, Javier Kajika and Vivian Conley — each holding a zone, with Keener waiting on Liberty Island. New Haven base, no district level gates, and yes, a puppy. The seasonal manhunts that followed all build on this hunt — see manhunts hub . New Endgame Level 40 & SHD Levels Cap rises 30 to 40 with a free boost, then infinite SHD points across Offense, Defense, Utility, Misc and endless Scavenging — your watch face shows it off. Gear 2.0 Every brand, set and exotic reworked; Skill Power removed; clearer stats; crafting bench scales to your level. Lady Death (Exotic SMG) Dark Zone sprinter's gun: speed for kills, at a cost. The Bighorn (Exotic AR) Legendary-difficulty trophy rifle. Tardigrade (Exotic Backpack) Full-armor emergency refill when your shell cracks. FAQ When did Warlords of New York launch? The expansion launched on March 3, 2020 as Title Update 8, taking agents to Lower Manhattan to hunt Aaron Keener. What are SHD levels? The infinite progression system past level 40: points go into Offense, Defense, Utility and Misc stats, then into endless Scavenging for materials. Notable Fixes The patch focused on community-reported bugs: account-wide sharing for Prototype cores, tiers and tokens; the Richter & Kaiser mod-strip bug; Oxpecker shield damage; reconfigure blueprints missing at Inaya; locked Legacy Manhunt climax entries; stuck Crossroads comms; and Danny Weaver's Rise Up cache purchases. Players affected by the missing Core Strength targeted loot received three Prototype Core Caches by logging in before May 26.
